droplets_of_thirst.ponder.sand_filter.he: Purifying Water with a Sand Filter
droplets_of_thirst.ponder.sand_filter.te: A Sand Filter purifies by one step water pumped through it
Dirty Water needs to be pumped in from the top...
and Purified Water can be pumped out from the bottom
A Wrench turns the filter: water always leaves on the side the bottom faces
Filters placed in a row facing the same way pass their water on, one step purer each
